name: ct_trauma_panscan
description: Order a trauma pan-scan (CT head, C-spine, chest, abdomen, and pelvis with IV contrast) for comprehensive evaluation of polytrauma patients.

contrast.description: IV contrast required (head non-contrast, then contrast for body)

clinical_indication.description: Mechanism of injury and presenting signs (e.g., MVC, fall from height, GCS)

when_to_use: high-energy trauma with altered mental status
polytrauma patient hemodynamically stable enough for CT
motor vehicle collision with multiple suspected injuries
fall from significant height with multiple areas of pain
stabbing or gunshot wound with uncertain trajectory

examples.query: High-speed MVC, GCS 13, hypotensive, multiple areas of tenderness

args.clinical_indication: polytrauma from high-speed MVC, hemodynamically borderline stable
